interpretation: Gaussian, positive-Gamma and bounded-uniform density marginals with the same P4AX mean/RMS produce nearly identical transmittance moments on all 15 frozen probes.
The maximum mean span is 5.28e-8 relative and the maximum RMS span is 0.0331%, so the retained amplitude consequence is robust to these three materially different marginal shapes.
This does not identify the true density marginal or any spatial spectrum. The compiled interval is an uncertainty bound, not an emulsion-geometry or photographic-render profile.
